items.title: EU proposes KIDS Act age gates for social media
items.summary: Commission would bar under-13s, limit 13–14s to parent-run mini accounts capped at one hour a day, and require safer defaults.

items.title: EU age-check app would power Kids Act enforcement
items.summary: Reuters explains Brussels’ privacy-preserving age app, rolling out via member states including Ireland.

items.title: From Australia to Europe, kids’ social media curbs spread
items.summary: Reuters maps new under-age bans and proposals after Australia’s under-16 rule and the EU Kids Act.
